intro.title: Making Hidden Systems Visible
intro.text: The systems around us shape how we live. What we own. What lasts. What powers our lives. How we connect and organise. These are shared questions, open to different perspectives.

paragraphs: The systems shaping our lives are designed, built and maintained by people. They influence what we own, what we value, how we work, what we can access and how we live together.

Creative people have always used tools to change how we see and shape the world. But today, the tools and systems surrounding creative work are increasingly built to extract value from it. We bring artists, designers, technologists, researchers and independent thinkers together to question that direction and help shape what comes next.
